summary: CPU/system capability detection and benchmark. Clears the output struct, copies a default 'unknown' string into the name buffer, queries GetSystemInfo, and on legacy Pentium-class processors (486/586) runs an RDTSC timing loop to estimate the clock speed in MHz. It then decodes CPUID vendor/model bits to build a human-readable CPU name and sets a performance tier (0-4) and feature flags (MMX/SSE/3DNow). Finally it queries GlobalMemoryStatus and stores physical/page memory sizes in the output struct; if a caller-supplied secondary object a2 has a positive field, it hands the name buffer and two output fields to sub_55BE20. Part of the render/UI global initialization.

local_names.this+0x24: flag set to 1 on unsupported/unknown CPU paths
local_names.this+0x8C: duplicate of total physical memory bytes
local_names.this+0x90: duplicate of available physical memory bytes
local_names.dwPriorityClass: measured clock speed in MHz after rounding

operations.description: Zero the output struct headers: *(_DWORD *)this = 0 and *((_DWORD *)this + 39) = 0 (tier and feature flags).
Copy the default aUnknown string into the name buffer v3 (this + 4 bytes), NUL-terminated byte copy.
GetSystemInfo(&SystemInfo): query processor type and vendor/system info.
If SystemInfo.dwProcessorType is neither 486 nor 586, jump to the tail (LABEL_74) and skip CPU timing/detection entirely.
CPUID probe via sub_5567F5; when it reports CPUID availability, run the benchmark block.
Benchmark setup: Sleep(0), GetCurrentProcess/GetPriorityClass to save the class, SetPriorityClass(current, 0x80) to raise to high priority, then reset the calibration counter v35.
Timer setup: sub_5567F5 again, sub_556220(v39), sub_556260(v39, 1), HighResolutionTimerReset(v39), then RDTSCTimestampRead(&v36, &v37) as the start timestamp.
Busy-wait loop while HighResolutionTimerDeltaCalculation(v39) < 0.25 (spin roughly a quarter second).
RDTSCTimestampRead(&v35 + 4, &v35) as the end timestamp, then SetPriorityClass(current, dwPriorityClassa) to restore the original priority, followed by EmptyStubWithFlagCheck(2, 0).

dwPriorityClassb = CRTFtol((((HIDWORD(v35) - v36) * 4294967296.0 * 0.000001 + ((unsigned int)v35 - v37) * 0.000001)) * 4.0): derive the raw clock estimate in MHz from the RDTSC delta; then EmptyStubWithFlagCheck(1, 0).

Round the MHz estimate: v14 = 50 * ((4 * dwPriorityClassb + 25) / 50); v15 = ((v14 & 3) + v14) / 4 - dwPriorityClassb; choose the smaller-abs-error of v15 + dwPriorityClassb versus 200 * ((3 * dwPriorityClassb + 100) / 200) / 3, producing the final dwPriorityClass.
v17 = sub_5567F5(...): second CPUID read carrying vendor and model bits in v18; v19 = v17 & 0x3000 selects the family class, and (v18 & 0xF00) selects the model family.
Intel path: when sub_588410(v3, aGenuineintel_0) reports the vendor is not 'GenuineIntel', apply the Intel naming branch.
Intel prefix: strcpy(v3, aDual) when family bits are 0x2000, else strcpy(v3, byte_5EA438); then switch on model bits to strcat the exact name (Pentium Pro/II/Celeron/III/4/MMX/Pentium).
Intel tier/flags: set this+0x9C feature bits (1 for MMX-only, 3 for SSE) and this+0x0 tier (0/1/2/3; Pentium II/III tier demoted to 1 when dwPriorityClass <= 400); Pentium 4 sets tier 3.
Fallback mark on the unsupported path: *((_DWORD *)this + 9) = 1 (this+0x24), then EmptyStub_7470(v39).
AMD path: when sub_588410(v3, aAuthenticamd_0) reports the vendor is not 'AuthenticAMD', apply the AMD naming branch.

AMD naming: strcpy aDual/byte_5EA438 prefix, then switch model bits to strcat K5/K6 MMX/K6-2/K6-III/Athlon/Duron/Athlon 4; sets feature bits (1 or 5) and tier (1/2/3; Athlon 4 demoted to 2 when dwPriorityClass <= 1200).
Cyrix path: when sub_588410(v3, aCyrixinstead) reports the vendor is not 'CyrixInstead', apply the Cyrix naming branch.
Cyrix naming: strcpy aDual/byte_5EA438 prefix, then switch on model bits to strcat MediaGX/6x86/MediaGX MMX/6x86MX; MediaGX MMX also sets feature bit 1.
Non-compatible fallback: v7 = aNonCompatibleC; this+0x0 = 0, this+0x24 = 0, and the aNonCompatibleC string is copied into the name buffer.
LABEL_75: Buffer.dwLength = 32; GlobalMemoryStatus(&Buffer): fetch physical/page memory totals.
If the measured dwPriorityClass is >= 1500, upgrade the tier: this+0x0 = 4.

Store memory stats: this+0x7C = dwTotalPhys, this+0x8C = dwTotalPhys (duplicate), this+0x80 = dwAvailPhys, this+0x90 = dwAvailPhys (duplicate), this+0x84 = dwTotalPageFile, this+0x88 = dwAvailPageFile, and this+0x28 = dwPriorityClass (MHz).
Tail: if a2 is non-null and SimpleFieldGetter_bfc0(a2) > 0, fetch v31 = BoundedArrayAccessor_bfd0(a2, 0) and return sub_55BE20(v31, this + 84, this + 37, this + 38).
Return result (the buffer or allocation pointer) when the a2 tail path is not taken.
Invoked by RenderUISystemGlobalInit.

clean_pseudocode: if (!sub_588410(v3, aGenuineintel_0)) { strcpy(v3, aDual/byte_5EA438); switch(model){...Intel names...}; setTierAndFlags(); }
else if (!sub_588410(v3, aAuthenticamd_0)) { strcpy(v3, aDual/byte_5EA438); switch(model){...AMD names...}; setTierAndFlags(); }
else if (!sub_588410(v3, aCyrixinstead)) { strcpy(v3, aDual/byte_5EA438); switch(model){...Cyrix names...}; }
